data.name: Feather
data.subtitle: On-device app manager, signer and installer
data.localizedDescription: Feather is a free on-device iOS and iPadOS application manager built with UIKit. Import your own developer or enterprise certificate to sign and install IPAs directly from the device, add AltStore-compatible repositories to browse and update apps, keep a library of signed and imported apps, and tweak bundle identifiers, display names, icons and injected dylibs per app - no computer or AltServer required.
data.versionDescription:
Feather 2.9.0 | Feather

Thank you for all your feedback and contributions!

> [!TIP]
> For `idevice` configuration, you can use [Impactor](https://github.com/claration/Impactor?tab=readme-ov-file#pairing-file) for easily retrieving a pairing file for installing!

## What's Changed
* Added tweak options in default signing options.
* Added ability to search for identifier's in Library @ismailcarlik in https://github.com/claration/Feather/pull/652
* Fixed issue in the file enumeration logic, by using the path property instead of method.
* Fixed credit links.
* Fixed duplicate repository in recommended repositories.

## New Contributors
* @xiangfeidexiaohuo made their first contribution in https://github.com/claration/Feather/pull/634
* @osageling made their first contribution in https://github.com/claration/Feather/pull/642

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/claration/Feather/compare/v2.8.2...v2.9.0
